quirks.condition: An R command laying out a document of more than one word.
quirks.effect: A word joins the line being built only when current_length + 1 + word_length is strictly less than the width, one character tighter than the incremental A path's less-than-or-equal rule, so a line the A path packed exactly full is split by the next R.

quirks.condition: An accepted W command while the layout has at least one non-empty line.
quirks.effect: Only the last existing line is re-wrapped at the new width using the incremental join rule and incremental (space-counting) digest lengths; earlier lines are left untouched.

quirks.condition: An A command whose word's width-length exceeds the current width, followed later by an R.
quirks.effect: The A is accepted and the word is placed on a line of its own with its full length recorded; the next R first truncates every stored word longer than the width to its first width characters, permanently, before laying out.

quirks.condition: A D command over lines built by different paths.
quirks.effect: Lines built by the A path record a digest length of the word characters plus one per joining space, while lines built by R record word characters only, so identical line counts from different histories can digest differently.

quirks.condition: An R command on an empty document.
quirks.effect: One empty line is laid out, R replies L 1 and D replies D 0; a subsequent A fills that empty line instead of starting a new one.
Only alphabetic characters count toward the width check on both layout paths, while the recorded digest length uses the full character count including digits.

quirks.condition: A W, A, R, or D command carrying more tokens than documented.
quirks.effect: The extra tokens are ignored and the command runs normally; reject replies are bare E codes.

unmapped_families.reason: Two mixed 150+ command corpora exercising every quirk above together with the documented behaviour; no single quirk maps.

A abcde
A abcde
R
' | .venv/bin/python builder/gold_reflowcore.py -> OK / L 1 / L 1 / L 2 / X 2 1 0
